chunks: 3034 - And Zurārah narrated from Ḥumrān, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
"Tafath is a man's abstaining from perfume; then when he completes his rite, perfume becomes permissible for him."

key_terms.التَّفَثَ: the state associated with post-ritual grooming matters in hajj, explained here in relation to abstaining from perfume
key_terms.نُسُكَهُ: his ritual act or rite of worship, especially the hajj rite

ai.seo_question: What does tafath mean in hajj, and when does perfume become permissible again?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the meaning of tafath in relation to the rites of hajj, identifying it as refraining from perfume during the state of ritual restriction. Once the pilgrim completes his nusuk, the use of perfume becomes lawful again.
